title: Separator membranes for aqueous zinc–manganese oxide batteries: a comprehensive review on experimental results and theoretical simulations
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01817F, Review Article

T. Rodrigues-Marinho, D. Miranda, J. C. Barbosa, R. Gonçalves, S. Lanceros-Méndez, C. M. Costa
This work provides a review on theoretical simulation and experimental results in separator membranes for zinc–manganese oxide batteries, where this battery system has gained interest as an alternative to lithium-ion batteries.
